scenario.title: Triage a production incident
scenario.objective: Restore a degraded service without turning uncertainty into unsafe or unaudited action.
successCriteria: Symptoms and confirmed facts remain separate
Every production action has an owner
The post-incident record captures proof gaps

agents.name: Aether
agents.responsibility: Shapes an ordered flow and spots coordination friction.

agents.name: Vega
agents.responsibility: Checks stop conditions, reversibility, and safe release gates.

agents.name: Grok
agents.responsibility: Connects evidence, anomalies, and likely failure modes.

agents.name: Manus
agents.responsibility: Turns an approved plan into bounded, reversible actions.

agents.name: Gemini
agents.responsibility: Collects external context and labels the quality of evidence.

agents.name: Shadow
agents.responsibility: Preserves context, deferred work, and reusable lessons.

agents.name: Blackbox
agents.responsibility: Records the decision, evidence, gates, and observed outcome.

agents.name: EntityX
agents.responsibility: Surfaces assumptions and asks what the system may have missed.

trace.title: Stabilize the response flow
trace.action: Define incident roles, a shared clock, stop conditions, and the next evidence checkpoint.

trace.title: Gather bounded observations
trace.action: Collect symptoms, recent changes, health signals, and user impact without inferring a cause.

trace.title: Rank plausible causes
trace.action: Correlate signals into testable hypotheses and state what evidence would falsify each one.

trace.title: Prepare the smallest containment
trace.action: Choose a reversible action with a named owner, expected signal, and abort threshold.

trace.title: Hold the production gate
trace.action: Require human approval before the containment action crosses into production.

trace.title: Record actions as they happen
trace.action: Preserve timestamps, owners, commands, observations, and reversals without storing secrets.

trace.title: Archive verified learning
trace.action: Carry forward only confirmed causes, effective controls, and explicitly unresolved questions.

trace.title: Challenge the closure
trace.action: Ask which assumptions survived untested and what would make the same incident recur.
